problem:

r=⟨1-3{t}^{2},\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t+1)⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the velocity vector $v.$

Question 3
?

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨1−3t2,sin⁡(2t+1)⟩,t>0. Calculate the velocity vector v.

a
v=⟨−6,cos⁡(2t+1)⟩
b
v=⟨−6t,−2cos⁡(2t+1)⟩
c
v=⟨−6t,2cos⁡(2t+1)⟩
d
v=⟨−6t,−cos⁡(2t+1)⟩
e
v=⟨−6,2cos⁡(2t+1)⟩
Submit
